origin.description: Build a style function from a builtin name, an R color name, a hex color, or three RGB numbers.
origin.usage: make_ansi_style(..., bg = FALSE, grey = FALSE, colors = num_ansi_colors())

arguments.name: style
arguments.text: Builtin name, R color name, #rrggbb, or three RGB integers.

arguments.name: bg
arguments.text: When true, a builtin name is used as a background color.

arguments.name: grey
arguments.text: Use the 256-color grey ramp for an RGB color.

arguments.name: colors
arguments.text: How many colors to target. None detects the count at creation.

origin.details: Fewer than 256 colors picks the nearest of the eight ANSI colors. 256 colors use the xterm cube, including the grey shortcut in cli's loop. True color uses a 38;2 or 48;2 sequence.
